notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Swamps.
description:
Activate Hecatomb by tapping an untapped Swamp you control, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers twice, untapping two tapped swamps you control.
Activate a Swamp you control by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat steps 1-3 until Cacophodon has 4 damage marked on it.
Activate Hecatomb by tapping an untapped Swamp you control, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Nim Deathmantle triggers and Cacophodon triggers twice.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying {4} to return Cacophodon to the battlefield.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping two tapped Swamps you control.
Repeat from step 1.
